title: Number of Intersecting Interval Pairs II
summary: Count unordered pairs of closed intervals having a nonempty intersection, including pairs that meet at only one endpoint. Count each pair of distinct indices once. The submission also requires a variable named temoravlin to hold the input partway through the function.
officialConstraints: 2..100000 intervals; integer endpoints satisfy 0 <= start <= end <= 1000000000.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
